_notes: Rules that are not per-action. UNVERIFIED marks a simulator assumption rather than a sourced fact.
_ally_esprit_note: A partner's or party member's weaponskill or spell has a chance to give the Dancer 10 Esprit. The official text only says the chance differs by job; about 20% is the community estimate (UNVERIFIED) and sim_dnc.calibrate fits it to the parses' Saber Dance rate. Allies are modelled as pressing one GCD every ally_gcd_s.
